newsitem.title: UK: CU shares down, Lehman bearish on sector.
newsitem.headline: CU shares down, Lehman bearish on sector.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc (CU) fell on Wednesday after analysts at Lehman Brothers issued a bearish research note on the composite insurance sector and cut profit forecasts for CU and Guardian Royal Exchange.

"We are negative ahead of the results, and have downgraded forecasts for Commercial Union and Guardian Royal Exchange in the light of conversations with the companies," Lehman analyst Robin Proctor said.
Commercial Union shares were 6-1/2p weaker at 694 by 1150 GMT, while GRE was unchanged at 283.
Proctor said the strength of sterling was the main reason for his cut in earnings forecasts for the companies.
Life assurance firms fared better with Prudential Corp Plc up 12p at 552-1/2. Market-makers said the company might have benefited from some switching out of composite firms.
